name: requirements-workshop
description: A structured, multi-turn requirements discussion workflow for Codex conversations.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify and confirm requirements through a focused chat workflow.
interface.longDescription: Runs a focused multi-turn product or task discovery conversation. It maintains a concise decision record, asks the next highest-value questions, and obtains a final requirements confirmation before implementation.
